";
  function fromB64(b){
    var bin=atob(b); var u=new Uint8Array(bin.length);
    for(var i=0;i<bin.length;i++) u[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);
    return u;
  }
  if(typeof DecompressionStream!=='undefined'){
    var ds=new DecompressionStream('gzip');
    var ab=fromB64(b64).buffer;
    new Response(new Blob([ab]).stream().pipeThrough(ds)).text().then(run).catch(function(e){console.error('IQ footer gunzip',e);});
  } else {
    console.error('IQ footer: DecompressionStream unsupported');
  }
})();
</script>
